title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
abstract: arXiv:2610.14118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. translated_title: ClawLoop：通过原生训练循环实现自我改进的智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展推动其部署向通用执行环境转变，基于LLM的智能体在沙箱工作空间中运行，并直接与文件系统和shell进行交互。尽管目前已有众多面向工具使用型智能体的后训练流水线，但针对基于执行环境的智能体的对应方法仍然稀缺，且大多是一次性的、依赖教师模型的方式：由更强的外部模型合成任务并收集轨迹，目标智能体仅被训练一次，评估结果由人类研究人员消费而非反馈到循环之中。此类流水线本质上受限于外部模型的能力和人类先验知识的范围，无法实现自我改进。为解决这些局限，我们提出了ClawLoop——一个无需任何外部教师模型、且先验依赖极少的自我改进框架。ClawLoop将三个阶段组合成……
tldr: 提出ClawLoop框架，通过无需外部教师模型的原生闭环训练流程，使智能体能够摆脱外部模型能力上限和人类先验的束缚，实现持续自我改进。
